rules.statement: Parties who have only received a transfer of rights do not acquire the standing to be added as parties in litigation.
rules.supporting_quote: (i) Though the 3rd Defendant - Respondent had transferred his right, title and interest to the 3rd, 23rd and 24th Defendants (Appellants) they had no right or status to be added as a party. (ii) They cannot be awarded undivided rights by the judgement and the interlocutory decree

rules.statement: Judgments and interlocutory decrees cannot confer undivided rights.
